work.author: GREGORIUS PP. XVI.
work.description: Letter CCLXXII (protocol LF47064–47067) privileges the high altar of the parish church of Caviola (Cadulae) in the diocese of Belluno, which the pope had served in his youth, and grants plenary indulgences on five Marian feasts, ending with its own 1 October 1833 closing at LF47137–47140, before numeral CCLXXIII at LF47143. Issuer evidence is GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF47064–47064; the source closing at LF47137–47140 reads: Datum Romae apud sanctam Mariam Maio- rem sub annulo piscatoris die prima octobris millesimo octingentesimo trigesimo tertio, pon- tificatus Nostri anno tertio. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
